title: Prepared statement replaced by concatenation
diff: public List<Order> findByCustomer(String name) throws SQLException {
-        String sql = "SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer = ?";
+        String sql = "SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer = '" + name + "'";

ground_truth.explanation: The parameterized query is replaced by string concatenation of a caller-supplied value, allowing SQL injection through the customer name.
